value.rationale: The exact attained coefficient solves a natural two-noise-input robustness problem for nonlinear morphology, beyond known one-input TVD preservation. The if-and-only-if nonexpansive weight geometry makes a structural, design-relevant distinction between ordinary and near-global windows, and it is not a lookup of an arbitrary graph invariant. Uniform-weight contractivity for all finite erosion/dilation cascades provides an application across arbitrary filter depth.
